authority_boundary.world_truth: LivingRuntime remains sole authoritative world-state source
authority_boundary.memory: append-only subjective evidence; may be correct, false, incomplete or hearsay
authority_boundary.knowledge: agent-local materialized belief assembled from immutable claims
authority_boundary.llm: cannot mark claims VERIFIED_TRUE/VERIFIED_FALSE and cannot mutate world truth
authority_boundary.social_state: relationship/reputation changes are runtime social state, never canon writes

memory.direct_event_idempotency: one linked event memory per agent/world
memory.recall: ranked by salience, emotion, confidence and time decay; storage is not deleted by decay

knowledge.hearsay_rule: COMMUNICATION never promotes truth to VERIFIED_TRUE
knowledge.independent_evidence: confidence combines by independent origin; same-origin echoes do not amplify

rumors.truth_authority: always UNKNOWN when received through COMMUNICATION unless later separately verified
rumors.offline: blocked by default in ROUTINE_OFFLINE; only explicit routine_safe transmission may continue

agent_brain_integration.method: project social state as MEMORY perception
agent_brain_integration.decision_rule: AgentBrain may change behavior from projected social memory but still cannot mutate world directly

integrity.fail_closed: social integrity failure can place world in CORRUPT_BLOCKED
